hypothesis: Three fixed synthetic native classifiers can produce fresh real proofs for the same transcript/context after program/key setup precedes completed classifier identities; a separate verifier rejects cross-context composition and wrong enrollment.
limitations: Only three fixed eight-byte synthetic requests; not the maximum-length three-classifier pipeline.
The encoder remains the frozen pass-all conformance fixture, and the response is authored without inference.
The controller pins real local setup keys before proving; no accepted setup ceremony, operational custody or authenticated relying-party enrollment is established.
The separate verifier is experimental and unaudited. No zero-knowledge, hiding, soundness-review, safety-policy or hardware claim follows.
The core qualification runner and full hybrid C0 verification remain separate gates.
Two runs check reproducibility of the fixed decisions and rejection roster; their timings are diagnostic observations, not latency distributions.
